description.value: Booster Juice is a Canadian fast-casual juice and smoothie chain with a location in Kamloops' Lansdowne Street commercial corridor. The menu centres on freshly blended smoothies, cold-pressed juices, açai bowls, and grab-and-go snacks designed for health-conscious customers on the move. A touring cyclist can stop here for a quick, portable nutrition boost without a long wait.
